Huawei SP310 Intel PCIe x8 Dual-Port 10G SFP+ Ethernet Network Card

High-Performance 10G SFP+ Converged Network Adapter for Enterprise & Data Centers
The Huawei SP310 Intel PCIe x8 Dual-Port 10G SFP+ Ethernet Network Card is a high-speed, ultra-reliable, and scalable networking solution designed for data centers, cloud environments, and enterprise networks. Powered by the Intel® 82599 10GbE Ethernet Controller, this network adapter delivers exceptional performance, advanced virtualization support, and unified networking capabilities for LAN, SAN, and IPC traffic.

Key Features 

  • Dual-Port 10G SFP+ Ethernet – High-speed, low-latency connectivity ideal for enterprise servers and storage networks.
  • Intel® 82599 10GbE Controller – Delivers exceptional reliability, power efficiency, and high-volume data transfer.
  • PCI Express 2.0 x8 Interface (5GT/s) – Provides high-bandwidth data transmission with minimal CPU overhead.
  • Unified Networking Support – Seamlessly integrates LAN, SAN, and IPC traffic for a simplified data center infrastructure.
  • Advanced Virtualization Features – Supports VMDq, SR-IOV, and Virtual Machine Device Queues (VMDq) for optimized cloud computing and virtualized workloads.
  • Energy-Efficient Design – Integrated SFI/KR PHYs ensure low power consumption and high performance.
  • iSCSI & Fibre Channel over Ethernet (FCoE) Support – Optimized for storage networking and cloud computing.
  • Extensive OS Compatibility – Supports Windows Server, Linux (RHEL, Ubuntu, Debian, SUSE), FreeBSD, and VMware.
  • Enterprise-Grade Reliability – RoHS-compliant, CE, and FCC-certified for data center and high-performance computing (HPC) environments.

Technical Specifications

  • General Specifications
  • Model: Huawei SP310
  • Controller: Intel® 82599 10GbE Ethernet Controller
  • Ports: Dual SFP+ 10G Ethernet
  • Interface: PCI Express 2.0 x8 (5GT/s)
  • Bracket: Full-height (low-profile included in package)
  • Form Factor: PCIe network adapter

Networking Features

  • Dual 10G SFP+ Ports – Supports Direct-Attached Copper (DAC) & Fiber-Optic Cables
  • IEEE 802.3 Compliant – Supports 10GBASE-SR, 10GBASE-LR
  • Receive Side Scaling (RSS) – Optimized multi-threaded data processing
  • Checksum Offloading & Jumbo Frame Support (Up to 15.5K) – Enhances network efficiency and reduces CPU load
  • Advanced Traffic Optimization – Supports interrupt throttling, load balancing, and RMON statistics monitoring
  • PXE Boot & iSCSI Remote Boot Support – Enables remote system deployment
  • Virtualization & Cloud Optimization
  • Supports VMDq & SR-IOV – Accelerates virtual machine networking and reduces CPU overhead
  • IPv4 & IPv6 Support – Future-proof networking for next-gen infrastructures
  • VXLAN & VLAN Support – Optimized for cloud environments and multi-tenant networks

Manageability & Security

  • PXE Boot, SNMP, RMON Support – Advanced network monitoring and remote management
  • Link & Activity LED Indicators – Visual status for easy troubleshooting
  • NC-SI (Network Controller Sideband Interface) – For seamless remote management
  • Cables & Connectivity
  • Supports SFP+ Direct-Attach Copper (DAC) Cables – Up to 10m
  • Supports LC-LC Fiber-Optic Cables – (Requires SFP+ optical transceivers)

Operating System Compatibility

  • Windows Client: Windows 10, 8.1, 8, 7
  • Windows Server: 2012, 2012 R2, 2016, 2019
  • Linux: Mikrotik ROS, RHEL 9.1 & 8.7, SLES 15 SP4, SLES 12 SP5, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS/20.04 LTS, Debian 11, FreeBSD 13/12.3
  • VMware: Fully supported for virtualization
  • Environmental & Power Specifications
  • Power Consumption: Max. 7.0W
  • Airflow Requirement: Minimum 100 LFM
  • Storage Temperature: -40°C to 70°C (-40°F to 158°F)
  • Operating Temperature: 0°C to 55°C (32°F to 131°F)
  • Storage Humidity: Up to 90% non-condensing at 35°C
  • Certifications: CE, FCC, RoHS

Ideal Applications

  • Enterprise Data Centers – Provides high-speed, low-latency networking for high-performance computing and cloud workloads.
  • Virtualized Environments – Supports VMDq, SR-IOV, and VXLAN for seamless cloud integration.
  • Storage Networking (iSCSI & FCoE) – Ideal for SAN, NAS, and high-performance storage applications.
  • High-Performance Computing (HPC) – Delivers ultra-low latency and high bandwidth.
  • ISP & Hosting Providers – Ensures scalable and reliable networking solutions.
  • Remote Server Management – NC-SI enables efficient out-of-band server management.

Why Choose the Huawei SP310 Dual-Port 10G SFP+ Ethernet Network Card?

  • Blazing-Fast 10G SFP+ Connectivity – Seamless, high-speed networking for data centers and cloud applications.
  • Intel® 82599 Controller – Optimized for high-reliability, power efficiency, and enterprise-grade performance.
  • PCI Express 2.0 (x8) Interface – Maximizes bandwidth and reduces CPU overhead.
  • Virtualization & Cloud-Ready – Supports VXLAN, VMDq, and SR-IOV for cloud-based deployments.
  • Unified Networking for LAN, SAN & IPC – Streamlines network infrastructure and improves efficiency.
  • Energy-Efficient & Reliable – Low power consumption and RoHS compliance for sustainable data centers.
  • Wide OS Compatibility – Supports Windows Server, Linux, VMware, and FreeBSD.
